purpose: Test a controlled extension of existing protocol projection transport. Extend an existing associated-text coordinate, retain the complete original test, and ask a model only which original observation projections remain guaranteed by the public contract.

policy.source: Only existing frozen original repository corpus test IDs; no new test extraction or outcome inputs.
policy.host: Python nonparameterized straight-line complete test; one direct fixture receiver feed with one literal complete CSI-u packet and singleton result unpacking. No helper, wrapper, receiver mutation or close.
policy.transform: Append original last text code point, U+0020, or U+0301, in that fixed order. All other raw wire bytes stay unchanged. These are text-cardinality and character-class refinements, not normalization equivalence.
policy.order: Original path/start, then fixed three transforms. Freeze first three slots per trial. No refill after omitted context, empty selection, invalid selection or review rejection.
policy.model: Low reasoning effort,8192 output tokens. Choose only immutable original assertion projection IDs for each frozen slot. No new expected value, code, input, receiver or ordering. Assertions containing calls or assignment expressions anywhere, including messages, are not transferable projections.
policy.source_guard: Preserve the existing CSI guard result. A missing connected protocol documentation keyword is only a candidate hypothesis when exact fixture/import/class/consumer sources resolve; full review must judge actual receiver domain.
policy.whole_test: Retain all original setup and assertions verbatim. Append one same-receiver call and selected old projections with only the observed-result name changed.
policy.review: Fresh complete P/Q plus explicit protocol association, original host, same-receiver reentry, text-domain and projection-invariance obligations. Source syntax and model projection selection are not admission.
policy.limitation: Development-selected finite domain extension of existing projection transport; no claim of a new mechanism or broad generalization.

selection_policy.ordering: sorted trial names; one non-retriable request per prepared trial

fresh_review_policy.ordering: original proposal ranks round robin over sorted trial names
fresh_review_policy.unknown: not executed; not an invalid-test judgment

source_boundary: Only frozen R18 original repository snapshots, existing corpus test IDs, public issue and source declarations/implementation context needed to inspect receiver association. No generated tests, model judgments, native outcomes, evaluator/reference or hidden data enter selection.

superseded_source_only_preparation.reason: Undispatched initial high-effort source preparation. Final root policy uses low effort and 8192 output tokens, and filters calls/assignment expressions over the entire assertion including its message. Do not dispatch this superseded directory.

denominator: 3029 frozen original test IDs across all 17 trials. The exploratory census saw 6103 top-level Python test definitions in complete source files, but only 1591 of those matched frozen IDs. Frozen IDs also include other languages and original extraction scope. No new test extraction or denominator substitution occurs here.
source_findings: The uniform direct-host rules admit two P1 source hosts. Fixed source order plus the three-slot cap retains all three transforms of the first host. The second host remains in the omission ledger. This is one applicable project, not evidence of cross-project generality.

P2 has an associated-text helper that closes the receiver with an empty feed; the same-receiver append rule abstains. P3 uses an unsupported list wrapper. The algorithm does not create alternative receivers or rewrite these hosts.

The existing CSI guard remains unchanged and preserves the keyword-unknown result. Exact fixture/import/class/consumer source makes a candidate inspectable, not valid. Fresh review must independently establish actual receiver protocol domain and reentry.

The static P1 failure hypothesis is root-supplied and source-checked. It is not a fresh execution or independently discovered detection. Transform selection is development-selected; append U+0301 is not normalization equivalence.
fresh_gate_obligations: Every original setup statement and assertion.
Actual receiver domain for original and appended packets.
Same-receiver second-call validity, including stream state and singleton unpacking.
Legality of the exact three fixed text extensions.
Contract invariance of every selected old assertion. No unchanged input coordinate alone proves invariance.

independent_readonly_review.scope: Current core, fresh-review wrapper and driver. Source-only review; no provider/native results.
notes: Singleton result unpacking is itself an oracle. Existing full P covers it, although an explicit per-obligation reminder could improve future prompts.

Rename does not model lexical shadowing in lambda/comprehension assertion messages. Current prepared host has no such message. This remains a general mechanical-renaming limitation; do not claim arbitrary assertion messages are supported.

validation.scope: Before the final two policy/filter changes; affected tests rerun afterward. Provider and native calls are mocks.

interpretation: This round jointly changes finite input-domain coverage, admissible source-association hypotheses and contract-guided projection selection. It is not a pure payload ablation, a new general protocol mechanism, or evidence of improved detection before execution and independent complete-test audit. Similar prior components do not settle novelty; any claim requires a problem-level gap and attributable increment with matched controls.

closeout.basis: Root closeout instruction reports that the execution window has ended. This round was prepared but not dispatched.

validation.scope: After final low/8192 and complete-Assert effect filtering changes.

closeout.validation_boundary: The 29 affected tests validate the implementation and mocked harness. They do not execute the target program or establish a defect detection.
closeout.hypothesis: P1 remains a source-only static hypothesis. This round did not dynamically confirm it. The hypothesis and prepared candidates must not be counted as a true positive.
closeout.rename_binder_limitation: The generic renamer does not model lexical shadowing in lambda or comprehension assertion messages. The prepared P1 host has no such shape. This limits the claim that arbitrary assertion messages can be transferred by changing only the observed-result reference.
closeout.next_stage_commands: Inactive historical preparation instructions. No provider or native stage may run within this closed window.
closeout.scope: Records-only closeout. No source, algorithm, candidate, prepared request, provider receipt or native artifact changed.
closeout.receipt_boundary: The existing source_census field retains its preparation-time receipt. source_census_closeout names the updated research record. The raw source census receipts and formal prepared/source hashes remain unchanged.
